        D[PUT /tasks/{id}] -->|invoke| update_task_lambda
        E[DELETE /tasks/{id}] -->|invoke| delete_task_lambda

    subgraph Lambda[Lambda Functions]
        create_task_lambda[create_task]
        list_tasks_lambda[list_tasks]
        get_task_lambda[get_task]
        update_task_lambda[update_task]
        delete_task_lambda[delete_task]
    end

        T[Tasks Table]
    end
    create_task_lambda -->|writes| T
    list_tasks_lambda -->|reads| T
    get_task_lambda -->|reads| T
    update_task_lambda -->|updates| T
    delete_task_lambda -->|deletes| T
